test_fork_with_statement: test that the with statement context manager works on LlvmEnv forks
test_fork_child_process_lifecycle: test that forked child processes are not orphaned when the parent service closes
test_fork_chain_lifecycle: test that a chain of forked environments shares one service and cleans up correctly
test_fork_before_reset: test that calling fork before reset starts an episode on both environments
test_fork_rewards: test that rewards are equal between parent and forked LlvmEnv after stepping with the same actions
